title: Dual-Channel Contrastive Encoding of Sperm Whale Coda
abstract: arXiv:2610.29101v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sperm whales (Physeter macrocephalus) communicate through short click sequences called codas, whose structure includes the rhythmic pattern of inter-click intervals (ICI) and the spectral composition of the clicks. In this paper, we propose the Dual-Channel Contrastive Encoder (DCCE), which explicitly encodes rhythm and spectral information with separate encoders before fusing them. We evaluate DCCE on three coda-understanding tasks: social unit, coda type, and individual identification. We compare DCCE against strong baselines from literature under a common linear-probe protocol and analyze the role of each channel and training objective through ablations. On 1,383 codas, shared partitions and validation-only layer selection support three random splits and three recording-date-disjoint folds. DCCE with unit pairing and type supervision achieves mean random-split macro-F1 of 0.901/0.865/0.597 for unit/type/identity. Raw ICI remains str

translated_title: 抹香鲸尾音序列的双通道对比编码
translated_abstract: 抹香鲸（Physeter macrocephalus）通过称为尾音序列的短促咔嗒声序列进行交流，其结构包括咔嗒声间隔（ICI）的节奏模式和咔嗒声的频谱组成。本文提出了双通道对比编码器（DCCE），该方法使用独立的编码器分别显式编码节奏信息和频谱信息，然后再进行融合。我们在三个尾音理解任务上评估了DCCE：社会单元识别、尾音类型识别和个体身份识别。我们在统一的线性探测协议下将DCCE与文献中的强基线方法进行比较，并通过消融实验分析了每个通道和训练目标的作用。在1,383个尾音序列上，采用共享的数据划分和仅基于验证集的层选择，支持三种随机划分和三种录音日期不相交的交叉验证。采用单元配对和类型监督的DCCE在单元/类型/身份任务上实现了平均随机划分的宏F1分数0.901/0.865/0.597。原始ICI数据仍然……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出双通道对比编码器（DCCE），通过分别编码并融合抹香鲸尾音的节奏与频谱信息，在社会单元、尾音类型和个体识别三个任务上取得了优异性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Dual-Channel Contrastive Encoder (DCCE), which separately encodes and fuses the rhythm and spectral information of sperm whale codas, achieving strong performance on social unit, coda type, and individual identification tasks.
